name: Ursa Major intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

u1.say: Keep your voice down — the interferometer is listening. You're here about the sun. Everyone is, lately.

u4.say: The Etna Diadem monks on Enceladus watch the deep current — monks notice what telescopes can't. Go gently. And if the sun flickers... call it in.

u2g.say: Gut? We're scientists, we don't... oh, fine. My gut says the sun is losing weight, and it is NOT on a diet.

u2.say: Solar mass is down three tenths of a percent in a single year. That does not happen. Something is siphoning the corona — and every tanker wake we track curves past Saturn into the deep system.
